mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend consistently reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as measured by the 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has decreased over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market contraction signaled by unemployment rate falling below 3.0% indicates strong economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by >0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal sustained consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches peak activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion as defined by GDP growth > 2% and unemployment < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation as measured by CPIAUCSL exceeding 300.0 index value signals monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a tightening labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained wage growth and consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE decreased by >0.2pp and PAYEMS increased by >0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery phases, rising industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal manufacturing and construction sector rebound, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during post-shock recovery as defined by GDP growth > 1.5% and industrial production > 100.
